title: Restricted complementary smart truncation comparison
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], L a cochain complex indexed by N, a an integer, and E its extension by zero to Z. Write R for restriction from Z to N, i for R(E.ιTruncLE(a-1)), and π_a for R(E.πTruncGE(a)). Let Q be any cochain complex indexed by N and π:R(E)→Q a cokernel cofork of i, including its colimit universal property. Any map g:Q→R(E.truncGE(a)) satisfying π≫g=π_a is a quasi-isomorphism. No totalization or bicomplex is involved.

source.place: shortComplexTruncLEX₃ToTruncGE and its QuasiIso instance, lines 306–328; CochainComplex.lean complementary integer embeddings

proof.text: Restriction preserves cokernels because colimits of homological complexes are degreewise. The given cokernel universal property identifies Q with the restriction of the integer cokernel of E.ιTruncLE(a-1), compatibly with π. The equation π≫g=π_a and cokernel uniqueness identify g with the restricted canonical complementary truncation comparison.

The embeddings at a-1 and a are complementary. Mathlib instQuasiIsoShortComplexTruncLEX₃ToTruncGE proves the integer comparison is a quasi-isomorphism. When a>0, its source and target are zero in all negative degrees: E is zero there, so the cokernel of the upper cutoff is zero there, and the lower truncation vanishes below a. Restriction therefore preserves homology: in degree zero both incoming images are zero; in positive degrees the three terms and differentials are unchanged. When a<=0 the cutoff is zero and the lower truncation changes only zero terms, so the comparison is an isomorphism. This covers a=0, a=1, zero complexes and complexes concentrated in degree zero. Transport quasi-isomorphism across the cokernel isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Canonical comparison with degreewise restriction and cokernel universal-property transport; second reader M2

lean.statement:
theorem restrictedComplementaryTruncationComparison_quasiIso
    (L : CochainComplex C ℕ) (a : ℤ) (Q : CochainComplex C ℕ)
    (π : (L.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat).restriction
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat ⟶ Q)
    (hzero : HomologicalComplex.restrictionMap
      (CochainComplex.ιTruncLE (L.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) (a - 1))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat ≫ π = 0)
    (hπ : IsColimit (CokernelCofork.ofπ π hzero))
    (g : Q ⟶ (CochainComplex.truncGE (L.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) a).restriction
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    (hg : π ≫ g = HomologicalComplex.restrictionMap
      (CochainComplex.πTruncGE (L.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) a)
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) :
    QuasiIso g
